consequences: Agents give up work by releasing their own claim or moving it to todo; people override from the UI or CLI, and every override is logged as them.
context: Phase 5b: a person at the board had no way to take over or release a task an agent held.
decision: releaseTask with force and takeOverTask refuse unless the caller is a human actor; the holder can always release, and anyone can release an expired claim. Rejected: letting any actor force, which would let agents take work from each other and undo atomic claims.
title: Only people can end another actor's live claim
